newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada vows to push for APEC free trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada vows to push for APEC free trade.

text.p: Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien vowed Thursday to make freer trade in the Pacific Rim a top priority when Canada takes over leadership of APEC after next week's summit in Manila.

"Our priority will be to help move APEC further along toward the goal of achieving free and open trade in the region...," he told a group of students during a stop in Vancouver on his way to the Philippines.
Vancouver will host next year's annual summit of the 18-nation Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum and Canada will chair the body for the next year.
Chretien said that although APEC's deadline for achieving trade liberalisation was in the next century, much could be done now.
He suggested that customs operations should be made more efficient through computerization and conditions for business improved.
